name: Screen Record (Linux)
summary: Record your X11 desktop to an MP4 file. Pick the display, set a bitrate, and start.
description: Captures an X11 display via ximagesrc, encodes with H.264 + AAC, and writes a self-contained MP4. Point it at any DISPLAY (`:0` is the standard local display; `:0.1` for a secondary screen if your DE exposes them as separate X displays). Default bitrate is 6 Mbps, suitable for documentation / demo recordings. Wayland sessions need a different capture (not included in this package).
